inputs.acceptance: Traceable physical identity and reviewed package pin mapping.
inputs.description: Capture DUT marking and package; establish exact suffix and package-specific pin table before assigning pads.

source_refs.paraphrase: The datasheet documents multiple package-specific pin configurations; a family name alone does not select one pinout.

actions.rationale: Capture DUT marking and package; establish exact suffix and package-specific pin table before assigning pads.

inputs.acceptance: Host identity, voltage limits and timing evidence tied to actual equipment.
inputs.description: Identify programmer and obtain documented drive/input limits, supported modes and clock/timing behavior; later authorized measurements must verify under load.

actions.rationale: Identify programmer and obtain documented drive/input limits, supported modes and clock/timing behavior; later authorized measurements must verify under load.

inputs.acceptance: Reviewed orderable BOM and package-to-symbol pad mapping.
inputs.description: Select TXU0304 orderable package and verify footprint, availability and assembly constraints.

actions.rationale: Select TXU0304 orderable package and verify footprint, availability and assembly constraints.

inputs.acceptance: Complete sourced worst-case DC and timing budget; no clock rate selected now.
inputs.description: Budget VIH/VIL against opposing VOH/VOL in both directions over supply, temperature and load; calculate SCLK/MOSI/CS setup/hold and MISO round-trip timing including translator delay/skew, wiring and host sampling. Select clock only after margins are established.

actions.rationale: Budget VIH/VIL against opposing VOH/VOL in both directions over supply, temperature and load; calculate SCLK/MOSI/CS setup/hold and MISO round-trip timing including translator delay/skew, wiring and host sampling. Select clock only after margins are established.

inputs.acceptance: Reviewed supply and OE design with defined disable states; no power authorization implied.
inputs.description: Specify local 1.8 V regulation, tolerances, current budget, decoupling, protection and shared reference. Resolve OE bias/control and all power sequencing states, including either rail absent, before implementation.

source_refs.paraphrase: The specified operating supply range is 1.7 V through 1.95 V.
Both supply rails have a recommended operating range beginning at 1.08 V and extending to 5.5 V.
Driving output enable low places all translator outputs in their high-impedance state.

actions.rationale: Specify local 1.8 V regulation, tolerances, current budget, decoupling, protection and shared reference. Resolve OE bias/control and all power sequencing states, including either rail absent, before implementation.

inputs.acceptance: Reviewed design artifacts and separately acquired physical evidence; all physical results currently absent.
inputs.description: After identity and electrical closure, produce schematic/BOM/PCB and ERC/DRC; obtain independent human/EE adjudication signoff. Plan subsequent separately authorized bench validation with measured rails, sequencing and SPI waveforms.

actions.rationale: After identity and electrical closure, produce schematic/BOM/PCB and ERC/DRC; obtain independent human/EE adjudication signoff. Plan subsequent separately authorized bench validation with measured rails, sequencing and SPI waveforms.
